This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win). The dominant strategy in second-price auctions is to bid exactly my true value. Bidding higher risks overpaying relative to my valuation, and bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Since my value is $20, bidding $20 ensures I win whenever the second-highest bid is below $20 (profitable), and I lose when others value it more, avoiding losses. This is optimal regardless of competitors' strategies.
